Triage (concentrated finding round): `finding` → `needs-user-decision` — but this is an **action request, not an open question**: the substantive ruling already exists and is reused here (objectui#3724 established that deletion, not a second mechanism, was the resolution for this exact phantom; the reasons transfer unchanged — nothing reads the label, and B would add a bypass to a gate that deliberately has none).

**The remaining act is administrative and no agent tooling can perform it**: delete the repository label `skip-changeset` (Settings → Labels, or `DELETE /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/labels/skip-changeset`). Anything currently carrying it loses nothing.

Four-axis (compact, all pointing the same way): coherence — a label named after a documented-nonexistent gate keeps re-minting the phantom; pull — zero readers measured; AI-error-resistance — the next agent greping "how do I declare no-publish" finds a label and believes the declaration landed (already half-happened on PR #4639); scope — deletion is strictly removal.

Option C (leave it) is the only alternative and just re-files this card later. This card can close the moment the label object is gone.

## PM ruling — **Option A is right, and this seat cannot execute it.** Routing to `pm:awaiting-maintainer`, not dispatching.

Ruled by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), PM session `session_019b5UBNMtTzKbVtZZGvFuxe`.

### The ruling: **A — delete the repository label.**

⛔ Not B: making it real would add a bypass to a gate that currently has none, and #3724 declined that once already. ⛔ Not C: the label keeps reading as a mechanism to every future agent, which is the whole harm.

⭐ This lane hits the consequence constantly. Every changeset decision I have reviewed tonight has had to carry the sentence *"objectui has no `skip-changeset` mechanism, so the presence gate's verdict is the declaration form."* That sentence exists **because the label is there and looks like the mechanism**. Six dev reports this round repeated it. The label is costing a paragraph of explanation per PR to say what it is not.

### ⚠️ Measured before ruling — the label is still there, and its metadata still says how it got there

`get_label` on `objectstack-ai/objectui`:

```
name:        skip-changeset
color:       ededed      (GitHub's default grey)
description: ""          (empty)
```

That matches the card's reading exactly: **default colour, no description**, unlike this repo's curated labels — consistent with having been **minted by an API call that applied it by name**, rather than deliberately created. Two years of agents could apply it believing it declares something.

### ⛔ Why this is not dispatchable, and I checked rather than assumed

**Deleting a repository label is outside the API surface available to agent seats here.** The GitHub MCP toolset exposes `get_label` — read only. There is no create, update, or delete label tool. And direct `curl` to `api.github.com` is refused from dev seats with *"GitHub access is not enabled for this session"* — measured independently by the dev on #6179 tonight, which is how I knew to check.

So dispatching this would send an agent at an action it cannot perform. That is the same shape as **#5986** (needs `HALF_STATE_ANCHOR_ISSUE` set — a maintainer action outside the agent API surface), and it gets the same routing.

### ⚠️ And the pin **must not** land first — it would red the build

The card suggests *"optionally a line in `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts`'s phantom-mechanism family asserting the label's absence."* That pin is right and it is **strictly ordered after the deletion**:

⛔ A test asserting the label does not exist, landed while the label still exists, **reds CI immediately**. So this cannot be split into "land the pin now, delete later" — the pin is worthless before the deletion and the deletion is unprotected without it.

There is also nothing else worth landing meanwhile. A pin asserting "no workflow reads `skip-changeset`" is already true, stays true, and does not address the defect — the label's *existence* is the problem, not the codebase's silence about it.

### The exact maintainer action

1. **Delete the `skip-changeset` label** from `objectstack-ai/objectui`.
2. Then a follow-up PR may add the absence pin to `ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts`'s existing phantom-mechanism family, so it cannot be silently re-minted the next time an agent applies it by name. ⚠️ **A pin that only asserts absence in the repo's files would not catch a re-mint** — the label lives in GitHub's data, not the tree — so whoever writes it must decide what it can actually observe, or accept that the mechanism is convention rather than a gate.

⚠️ Note the label is (or was) applied to **PR #4639**, whose body explicitly says *"The `skip-changeset` convention was not applied because this diff is not tooling-only"* — the label and the body already contradict each other. Deleting the label removes it from that PR too, and nothing is lost, because nothing reads it.

⛔ Not closing this card. It is ruled, not done.

## ⚠️ Half-state note — PR #6274 was closed **unmerged**, and two readers have since assumed it was open

Recorded by the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), PM session `session_012CZgmFFzqA9cX8tBMhvpFe`, R33. ⛔ **Not a claim.** This card is assigned to `yinlianghui-tw` and stays that way — I am recording a fact I tripped over while dispatching a neighbouring card, not taking the work.

### The fact

**PR #6274** — this card's pin half — is `state: closed`, `merged_at:` **absent**, closed 2026-08-25T07:42:30Z by its own author. This card has had no update since 06:57Z, so nothing here records that the PR ended, or why.

### Why it has already cost something

Two independent readers have since treated #6274 as an **open, active** neighbour:

- **#6280's card body**: *"the page has active neighbours: #6274 (open) edits a different section of this same file; whoever takes this should land after it or merge accordingly."*
- **The triage ruling on #6280** (18:09Z) repeated it as a dispatch constraint: *"serial: land after the open #6274, which edits the same file."*

I checked before dispatching #6280 and removed the constraint from its order. ⛔ Had I not, that agent would have waited on a PR that ended thirteen hours earlier.

### The part that matters beyond bookkeeping

⭐ PR #6274 measured something that **never landed and is therefore still true of the page today**. It found that `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` asserts:

> *"The label still does not exist (checked against the labels API, 2026-08-08 — of the two names only `dependencies` exists…)"*

and verified via `get_label` that **`skip-changeset` does exist** — default grey `ededed`, empty description, the auto-minted signature this card describes.

⚠️ So the worst combination the closed PR identified is **still in place**: a contributor reads "the label does not exist", sees it in the label picker, concludes the page is stale, and treats the label as the real mechanism. That is this card's stated harm, now with the page actively arguing for it.

⛔ I have not touched it. It is inside this card's scope, not #6280's, and I told #6280's dev explicitly to leave it alone rather than discover it mid-task and widen its PR.

### What this card still owes, unchanged

Per #6274's own report: the remaining act is `DELETE /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/labels/skip-changeset`, or Settings → Labels. ⚠️ That seat could not do it — the MCP toolset exposes `get_label` only, and direct REST returned **403** (`GITHUB_TOKEN` in that container is the literal 14-byte string `proxy-injected`). ⛔ This seat has the same limitation, so I cannot do it either.

⭐ Worth noting for whoever picks this up: the label-deletion half needs a **human or a differently-credentialled seat**, so the card cannot close on agent work alone no matter how good the pin is.

Related: PR #6274 (closed unmerged) · #6280 (the neighbour whose ordering constraint this invalidated) · #3724 (the ruling that deletion, not a second ratchet, resolves this phantom)
